The '''MC75C Star Cruiser''' was a class of [[Mon Calamari]] [[Star Cruiser]] present in the [[Citizens' Fleet]] during the [[Battle of Exegol]]<ref name="Every Ship in ST" /> in [[35 ABY]] between the [[Resistance]] and the [[Sith Eternal]].<ref name="Exegol Date">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' dates the events of ''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'' as taking place one [[Standard year|year]] after the [[Hosnian Cataclysm|Starkiller Incident]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[34 ABY]]. Therefore, the events of ''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'' must take place in [[35 ABY]].</ref>

==Characteristics==
The MC75C Star Cruiser shared a similar hull shape to that of a standard [[MC75 Star Cruiser]], with notable differences being an aileron that was erected at the stern<ref name="Ships">{{EncyclopediaCite|Starships of the First Order and the Resistance}}</ref> and contained the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] compartment at the end,<ref name="Episode IX" /> similar to the module used by the standard MC75<ref name="Rogue One">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> but placed above instead of below the hull. The MC75C was also identified by a topside ridge that ran along the hull from the bow, and a pod below the hull. The MC75C was also equipped with a [[hyperdrive]], allowing it to traverse [[hyperspace]] on its way to the [[Unknown Regions]].<ref name="Episode IX" />

==History==
When [[Darth Sidious]] planned to unleash the [[Sith Eternal]]'s [[fleet]], the [[Final Order]], upon the galaxy in [[35 ABY]], many MC75C Star Cruisers were among the massive [[Citizens' Fleet]] amassed by General [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] to travel to [[Exegol]]. Several of the craft were ordained with [[color]]ful markings along their hull. After the defeat of Sidious at the hands of the [[Jedi]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]], the remaining Sith forces were defeated and the Citizens' Fleet emerged from the Sith world.<ref name="Episode IX" />

==Behind the scenes==
The MC75C Star Cruiser first appeared in the final installment of the [[Star Wars saga|''Star Wars'' saga]] and the [[sequel trilogy]], [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']]. It was first identified in an installment of ''[[Star Wars By the Numbers]]'' on [[StarWarsKids.com]] in [[2020]].<ref name="Every Ship in ST" /> When developing ships for the [[Citizens' Fleet]], the production team turned to some existing models to help fill out the scenes. The MC75C was created by modifying the existing [[MC75 Star Cruiser]] model created for [[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]].<ref name="A Final Alliance">{{HomeVideoCite|set=Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker (Target Exclusive)|featurette=A Final Alliance}}</ref>
